🚀 Meet Team LunaShift! 🌕

We're a team of passionate space explorers competing in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026!

Our project, Lunar Landing Site Navigator, uses NASA datasets to evaluate potential Moon landing sites through interactive visualization and scientific analysis.

We're looking for developers, engineers, designers, and scientists who enjoy tackling exciting challenges.

All skill levels are welcome! Join us, and let's explore the Moon together! 🚀🌕
